summary: Settings opens as one window with a navigation rail
description: Settings used to be spread over several dialogs. Make Settings a single window, opened from the gear icon in the sidebar footer, with every settings page listed in one navigation rail on the left.
acceptance: Clicking the gear in the sidebar footer opens the Settings window on its Overview page
The rail lists every settings page, from Overview to Archive
Clicking a page in the rail shows that page without closing the window
